title: Hamburg Acute Kidney Injury Study (HAKIS)
summary: The Hamburg Acute Kidney Injury Study (HAKIS) is a prospective observational cohort study aimed at investigating the mechanisms, risk factors, and clinical determinants of acute kidney injury (AKI) trajectories and consequences.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hospitalized individuals with acute kidney injury (AKI), defined by the 2012 Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) criteria or hospitalized individuals with acute illness who have not developed AKI (control group)
* Age ≥ 18 years at time of enrollment
* Written informed consent provided by the participant or, in participants lacking decision-making capacity, by a legal representative or healthcare proxy, where available. Participants lacking decision-making capacity without an available legal representative or healthcare proxy may be enrolled if participation is not contrary to their presumed wishes, in accordance with the ethics committee-approved consent procedure. Written informed consent is subsequently sought from the participant upon regaining decision-making capacity or from a legal representative, as applicable.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
